clos.original_description: Understand the basics of the R language
clos.enriched_description: Understand the basics of the R language. The scope includes Introduction to R Language 1 and Introduction to R Language 2.

clos.original_description: Understand how manipulate data with R programming language and implement fundamental programming tasks
clos.enriched_description: Understand how manipulate data with R programming language and implement fundamental programming tasks. The scope includes Getting Data into R 2, Getting Data into R 3, Getting Data into R 4, Getting Data into R 5, R Programming Fundamentals 1, R Programming Fundamentals 2, Lab 1a: Introduction to R Programming, Lab 1b: Introduction to R Programming, and Lab 1c: Introduction to R Programming.

clos.original_description: Learn and apply foundational knowledge of the SQL &R languages, and how to access databases from Jupyter notebooks using SQL and R
clos.enriched_description: Learn and apply foundational knowledge of the SQL &R languages, and how to access databases from Jupyter notebooks using SQL and R. The scope includes SQL for Data Science with R, Remind: Relational Databases and Tables, Remind: Intermediate SQL, Getting Started with Databases using R 1, Getting Started with Databases using R 2, Working with Database Objects using R 1, Working with Database Objects using R 2, Working with Database Objects using R 3, Lab 2a: SQL with R, Lab 2b: SQL with R, Lab 2c: SQL with R, and Lab 2d: SQL with R.

clos.original_description: Know how to wrangle data for data analysis, develop models, improve models, evaluate and tune the performance
clos.enriched_description: Know how to wrangle data for data analysis, develop models, improve models, evaluate and tune the performance. The scope includes Data Analysis with R, Introduction to Data Analysis with R 1, Introduction to Data Analysis with R 2, Exploratory Data Analysis 1, Exploratory Data Analysis 2, Model Development in R 1, Model Development in R 2, Model Development in R 3, Lab 3a: Data Analysis with R 1, Lab 3b: Data Analysis with R 2, Lab 3c: Data Analysis with R 3, and Lab 3d: Data Analysis with R 4.

clos.original_description: Understand how to describe and build graphs using R packages. Implement various types of basic charts to visualize like bar charts, histograms, pie charts, scatter plots, line plots, and box plots
clos.enriched_description: Understand how to describe and build graphs using R packages. Implement various types of basic charts to visualize like bar charts, histograms, pie charts, scatter plots, line plots, and box plots. The scope includes Basic Plots, Maps, and Customization 1; Basic Plots, Maps, and Customization 2; and Basic Plots, Maps, and Customization 3.

clos.original_description: Implement a small data science project includes steps: data wrangling, data analysis, data visualization, model development, model evaluation, and reporting
clos.enriched_description: Implement a small data science project includes steps: data wrangling, data analysis, data visualization, model development, model evaluation, and reporting. The scope includes Review the mini Capstone.
